workflow.title: How AgriSync Works
workflow.subtitle: A frictionless 4-step digital journey from farm booking to bank credit.

step1.title: Register
step1.headline: Book a slot from home.
step1.desc: Select your preferred Mandi, specify crop type and estimated tonnage, and reserve a guaranteed arrival time window.

step2.title: Get Token
step2.headline: Receive a live digital queue number.
step2.desc: Get an instant SMS and electronic QR gate pass with real-time queue position tracking and dynamic wait-time updates.

step3.title: Arrive
step3.headline: Enter the Mandi precisely when called.
step3.desc: Arrive at the exact summoned gate or weighbridge, eliminating days of chaotic tractor-trolley highway bottlenecks.

step4.title: Get Paid
step4.headline: Transparent weighing and instant DBT.
step4.desc: Certified moisture lab analysis and digital weighbridges trigger immediate Direct Bank Transfer to your bank account.

portals.title: Role-Based Portal Access
portals.subtitle: Sign in securely using Mobile OTP or Email OTP to access your designated workspace.

farmerCard.title: For Farmers
farmerCard.desc: Verify via Mobile OTP (SMS) or Email OTP to book delivery slots, track live tokens, and download QR gate passes.

operatorCard.title: For Mandi Operators
operatorCard.desc: Call next queued trucks, record laboratory moisture %, weigh loads, and disburse DBT payments.

adminCard.title: For State Admins
adminCard.desc: Multi-state APMC monitoring, weighbridge operations, live congestion heatmaps, and procurement quotas.

footer.tagline: India's smart agricultural procurement queue management and real-time scheduling ecosystem for APMC mandis.
footer.compliance: Compliant with Ministry of Agriculture & APMC Mandi Framework
